summary: Distinguish completed snapshot preparation from unavailable Bitcoin progress observations
details: A matching preparation completion record and a successfully exited bootstrap job keep the snapshot preparation stage complete during Core probe outages; fresh identity or preparation failures remain visible.
Native Bitcoin progress shows STALE or UNAVAILABLE instead of implying process startup after an unsuccessful probe, while preserving current container failures.
Bounded watch history retains foreground and background progress from the same successful observation, with explicit time, age, last state and the latest probe error on separate lines.
Restart and release identity changes clear cached observations; stale values never authorize startup or mining and never produce synchronization ETA estimates.
operator_actions: Use the updated node tools and reopen status --watch; persistent RPC or controller failures still require log inspection.
